description: This file defines a React component named RoleCard used in the 'explore' section of a Next.js frontend, responsible for displaying detailed information about a role, managing user interactions such as expanding/collapsing, setting target roles, and navigating to detailed views.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts a value to a trimmed string, handling undefined or null gracefully.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to an array of strings, filtering out invalid entries.

methods.name: toBulletedSentences
methods.description: Transforms array of strings into cleaned-up, sentence-like strings with proper punctuation.

methods.name: clampPercent
methods.description: Ensures a number is within 0-100 bounds after rounding.

methods.name: roleIdFromRole
methods.description: Extracts a role ID from various role object formats.

methods.name: extractPersonaSkills
methods.description: Defensively extracts a list of skills from a persona object, deduplicating while preserving order.

methods.name: normalizeSkillKey
methods.description: Normalizes skill strings for comparison by trimming and lowercasing.

methods.name: intersectSkills
methods.description: Finds skills in persona skills that match required skills, returning a deduplicated list.
